  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    repeat' apply List.Subset.app
    all_goals
      apply List.Subset.trans
      · assumption

  case app ih1 ih2 =>

        simp_all
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        exact ih2 Hin
    · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
      apply List.Subset.app
      · exact List.Subset.trans ih1 (by simp [List.Subset, or_assoc, or_left_comm, or_comm])
